## Feature Description
A clear description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Authenticity Consideration
How does this relate to the original 1983-1986 CBS game show?
- [ ] This matches the original show
- [ ] This is an enhancement beyond the original
- [ ] This is a quality-of-life improvement

## Use Case
Describe the problem this feature would solve or the value it would add.

## Proposed Implementation
If you have ideas on how to implement this, describe them here.

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions you've considered.

## Additional Context
Screenshots, episode references, or other relevant information.
